reviews.title: Excellent value, good features
reviews.comment: Good value motherboard with good features. Worth the money.
reviews.author: Jeremy Dale

reviews.title: Feature rich for $130
reviews.comment: Rear usb-c gen 3.2 2x2 (video capable), wifi/BT, 2.5gig lan, support for any size m2 out of the box, even 2230, 5 fan headers in a slim m-atx form factor - you could do a lot worse for $130.
reviews.author: Maize16
